description: The primary financial statements are absent as units. The extraction reads the narrative sections and stops: there is no unit stating net income, operating cash flow, total revenue, or total shareholders' equity, though each is a headline figure of the filing. The tables are all present as assets and each is now anchored, so anything extracted from those passages will carry them -- but nothing was extracted from those passages.

The pension position is not represented. The plan funded status table carries seventy-eight figures across thirty-four rows and is the largest single table in the filing; no unit states the deficit, the discount rate, or the expected return assumption.
excerpt: PLAN FUNDED STATUS AND AMOUNTS RECORDED IN ACCUMULATED OTHER COMPREHENSIVE LOSS

description: The effective tax rate reconciliation is absent. The filing reconciles the U.S. federal statutory rate of 21.0% to the effective rate line by line, and no unit carries either the effective rate or any reconciling item.
excerpt: RECONCILIATION OF U.S. FEDERAL STATUTORY INCOME TAX RATE TO EFFECTIVE INCOME TAX RATE
